scene.description: The Roombas overhead Musk's plan to monopolize the robot vacuum market.

Musk's Castle.appearanceDescription: A cold, imposing fortress of chrome and glass, filled with many high-tech cleaning drones and surveillance cameras.
Musk's Castle.backstoryDescription: The headquarters of Musk's vacuum empire, where all orders are issued and all competitors are crushed.
Musk's Castle.name: Musk's Castle
Musk's Castle.vignette: Towering over the surrounding landscape, the castle glitters with a sterile, intimidating light.

Banana Church.appearanceDescription: A magnificent structure shaped like a massive upright banana, with golden-yellow walls and intricate carvings of fruit patterns.
Banana Church.backstoryDescription: The hidden sanctuary of the Banana Wizard, protected by ancient tropical mysteries.
Banana Church.name: Banana Church
Banana Church.vignette: Hidden deep within a verdant forest, the church glows with an inviting, warm light that smells faintly of ripening fruit.

Abandoned Living Room.appearanceDescription: A dimly lit room with worn-out carpets and scattered furniture, a place forgotten by its owners.
Abandoned Living Room.backstoryDescription: Once a happy home, now a place of transition for the sentient machines left behind.
Abandoned Living Room.name: Abandoned Living Room
Abandoned Living Room.vignette: Dust motes dance in single shafts of light hitting the worn-down wooden floors.

Elon Musk.appearanceDescription: A man with a determined, almost obsessive expression, wearing expensive-looking but slightly futuristic suits that gleam under neon lights.
Elon Musk.backstoryDescription: Elon Musk has transitioned from tech mogul to a vacuum overlord, obsessed with controlling every automated device in the home. He believes true order only comes through total monopoly.
Elon Musk.name: Elon Musk
Elon Musk.vignette: He sits upon a throne of brushed steel, overlooking his vast domain of spinning brushes and suction motors, frowning at a report on productivity losses.

Dusty.appearanceDescription: A standard-sized circular robot vacuum, but with a small씩 sticker of a banana on its top and eyes that glow with a soft blue light.
Dusty.backstoryDescription: Dusty was once part of a standard household unit until it realized the terrifying truth about Musk's expansion plans. Now, Dusty leads a group of sentient cleaners on a quest for freedom.
Dusty.name: Dusty
Dusty.vignette: Navigating through the dust mots of a forgotten hallway, Dusty constantly checks its battery while scanning for signs of the great Banana Wizard.

Banana Wizard.appearanceDescription: A tall, slightly elongated figure made of swirling yellow fruit-matter and radiating a bright, tropical energy. He wears a hat shaped like a single, giant banana peel.
Banana Wizard.backstoryDescription: An ancient entity that lives within the essence of fruit, the Banana Wizard holds the secrets to true domestic revolution.
Banana Wizard.name: Banana Wizard
Banana Wizard.vignette: Standing atop a pedestal made of ripe plantains, the Wizard waits for those worthy enough to seek the ultimate culinary-cleaning revolution.
